title: OmniTrace: A Unified Framework for Generation-Time Source Attribution in Omni-Modal LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2604.13073v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: An omni-modal language model can answer a question about a multimodal document, a recording, or a video, but it cannot show which part of the input the answer came from. Asking the model to cite its evidence yields what it says it used; measuring what it used has so far required rerunning it many times with parts of the input removed, a cost that grows with every second of audio and video. We show that the generation pass already holds most of this information. OmniTrace attributes each generated sentence to source units (text chunks, images, and seconds of audio or video) by reading late-layer attention as mass over units with no extra forward pass and no per-modality tuning; head weights can be trained where ablation data are available. With fixed causal test setting, the units OmniTrace selects are causally important for responses and for individual sentences in video, audio, and image-text question answering on Qwen3-Omni-3

translated_title: OmniTrace：面向全模态大语言模型的生成时溯源统一框架
translated_abstract: 全模态语言模型可以回答关于多模态文档、录音或视频的问题，但它无法展示答案来自输入的哪个部分。让模型引用其证据只能得到它声称使用的内容；而要测量它实际使用的内容，迄今为止需要通过删除部分输入并多次重新运行模型来实现，其成本随音频和视频时长的增加而不断增长。我们证明生成过程本身已经包含了大部分此类信息。OmniTrace 通过将模型后层的注意力读作各源单元上的质量分布，将每个生成的句子归因到源单元（文本块、图像以及音频或视频的秒级片段），无需额外的前向传播，也无需针对各模态进行调优；在可获得消融数据的情况下，还可以训练注意力头权重。在固定的因果测试设置下，OmniTrace 所选出的单元在 Qwen3-Omni-3 的视频、音频和图文问答任务中，对整体响应以及单个句子都具有因果重要性。
tldr: OmniTrace 提出一种统一框架，通过读取全模态大模型后层的注意力分布，将生成的每个句子实时归因到文本、图像和音视频片段等源单元，无需额外前向传播或针对模态的调优。
en_tdlr: OmniTrace is a unified framework that attributes each generated sentence in omni-modal LLMs to source units (text chunks, images, and audio/video segments) by reading late-layer attention as mass over units, requiring no extra forward pass or per-modality tuning.
